_comment: Projection of CARD_REGISTRY[kind].aiRequest (src/cards/card-registry.tsx) — the FROZEN wire routing for the card-flag -> ai-requests.json bridge. `kind` is the AiRequest.kind a subskill dispatches on; `linkPanel` is the AiRequestLink.panel token. This is the single source both the TS bridge and the Python drain (list_requests.py) read, so they can't disagree about kinds or fallback coverage. PINNED against the registry by src/cards/__tests__/ai-request-routing-manifest.test.ts: a registry edit that changes the routing must regenerate this file or the test fails. Do NOT hand-edit the routing map; mirror the registry.
